<!--
Data-model directory TreeView diagram + fragment overlays for the
"Data model tracked in a GitHub repo" slide. Pulled into the deck with an
include shortcode pointing at this file.

The {r} chunk renders the mermaid source to SVG at build time (mmdc with
bundled mermaid >= 11.14.0 for treeView-beta). The .mmd carries no inline
descriptions; the lab_tests / lab_test_codes annotations live here as HTML
overlays instead, revealed on the same fragment as the highlight boxes.

Geometry: the SVG viewBox is 271.6 x 445 with rows every 32 units starting
at y=45. The image is sized by HEIGHT (605px) to fill the slide under the
title; its width follows the ~271:445 aspect. The wrapper is sized to the
image, so overlay percentages map directly onto the viewBox regardless of
image size: left/width are % of 271.6, top/height are % of 445.
Highlighted pairs (datasets that need more than one file):
  lab_tests(173) + lab_test_codes(205)      -> 35.3% .. 49.7%
  response(269) + response_params(301)      -> 56.9% .. 71.2%
  time_to_event(333) + time_to_event_params(365) -> 71.2% .. 85.6%
-->
```{r}
#| include: false
# Render the TreeView diagram to SVG with mermaid-cli.
# Requires mmdc (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) with bundled mermaid >= 11.14.0 for treeView-beta.
system("mmdc -i data-model-directory-treeView.mmd -o assets/data-model-directory-treeView.svg -b transparent")
```

  <!-- Row-pair highlight boxes (BMS theme colors, not purple) -->
  <div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1" style="position: absolute; top: 35.8%; left: 3%; width: 95%; height: 13.4%; border: 2px solid #3312AF; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(73, 111, 227, 0.15);"></div>
  <div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2" style="position: absolute; top: 55.9%; left: 3%; width: 95%; height: 13.4%; border: 2px solid #3312AF; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(73, 111, 227, 0.15);"></div>
  <div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2" style="position: absolute; top: 69.7%; left: 3%; width: 95%; height: 13.4%; border: 2px solid #3312AF; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(73, 111, 227, 0.15);"></div>
